methods.name: Terminal check
methods.description: Scripted PTY interaction with any terminal program; transcript and checkpoint expectations produce an automatic verdict.
methods.verdict_contract: all declared transcript checkpoints are reached and pass

methods.name: Terminal inspection
methods.description: Capture the real Terminal at declared checkpoints, then judge the captures against the expected outcome.
methods.verdict_contract: agent inspection of paired Terminal capture against expected outcome
methods.evidence_contract: paired text and Terminal screenshots with explicit degraded-capture reason

methods.name: Machine state check
methods.description: Run argv-shaped shell assertions on the controlled host for files, services, auth bindings, or other provisioning claims.
methods.verdict_contract: every host assertion exits with its declared status
methods.evidence_contract: assertion argv, redacted output, exit status, and secret scan
